## Component groups

- **Navigation:** Compact bottom bar; medium/expanded rail; large permanent drawer. Compact-height windows prioritize rail navigation.
- **Surfaces:** Material 3 cards, outlined cards, grouped settings surfaces and empty states.
- **Actions:** Primary and outlined buttons, import/export actions and filter chips.
- **Status:** Text-labelled job states and capability maturity labels; colour is never the only signal.
- **Research context:** Research Mode and local-first privacy context; full persistent global chips remain open.
- **Scientific data:** Sequence, structure, chart and provenance viewer components remain planned.

## Shared layout tokens

- Spacing: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 dp.
- Corner radii: 4, 8, 12, 16, 28 dp.
- Minimum touch target: 48 dp.
- Target spacing: 8 dp.
- Maximum readable content width: 840 dp.

## Proof status

The development gallery composable lives in android/designsystem. It is not yet exposed through a debug-only route/activity. Compact/medium/expanded screenshots, light/dark/neon contrast checks, TalkBack, 200% text, RTL and foldable tests remain open.
